context: A flooded city at night. Two strangers on a rescue boat each offer to save you: a ship captain and a doctor.
The moon is breaking apart above a huge spaceship. The hull is cracking and the crew is panicking. Two crew members each offer you a seat on the last escape pod: an engineer and a priest.

Year 2091, you wake up alone in an underground bunker after the surface war. The air filters are failing and the lights flicker. A soldier with a radio and a nurse with the last medicine each tell you to follow them. One of them knows the bunker is not what it seems. The only exit door opens once, at dawn.

Une ville de montagne est ensevelie sous la neige depuis trois jours. Le téléphérique est en panne et la nuit tombe. Deux inconnus vous proposent de vous sauver : un guide de haute montagne et une médecin.
